responsibility: Declares an older low-level time-and-date binding layer to libc/POSIX time primitives. It provides opaque timeval, timezone, and tm handles; allocation and destruction routines for those objects; wrappers for gettimeofday, settimeofday, and localtime_r; field accessors for broken-down local time and timezone data; and setters that populate timeval/timezone structures, supplying a direct host-interface module distinct from the newer wrapclock timespec-based clock API.
